columns.header: Global Axis Forces and Moments [Note Fy, N (lb) (Signed) [Note (2)]

notes: (1) Reactions are averaged from commercial programs’ results and are obtained by analyzing the piping system in both U.S. Customary and SI units.
(2) Reactions are signed based on their directions relative to the selected coordinate system’s positive directions. Reactions Fx and Mz are positive in sign for anchor 110.
